newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malaysia sets August Tapis crude at $21.19/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia sets August Tapis crude at $21.19/bbl.

text.p: Malaysian state oil company Petronas has increased its August lifting Tapis crude oil price by 33 cents to $21.19 per barrel against $20.86 in July traders said on Thursday.
For September, Petronas set a premium of 40 cents per barrel for term crude oil sales, up 5 cents from August, they said.
Current fixed differentials against Tapis for other Malaysian grades Labuan and Miri are unchanged, with Labuan 10 cents above Tapis, Miri 10 cents below Tapis and Bintulu 30 cents below Tapis.
The price of August Dulang has been fixed at $20.38 per barrel against $20.27 for July.
Terengganu condensates has been fixed at $19.99 and Bintulu condensates at $20.09.
AUGUST JULY JUNE MAY APRIL MARCH FEBRUARY
